event: Damiano David, Victoria De Angelis and Thomas Raggi (schoolmates in Rome) form a band; Ethan Torchio joins after answering a Facebook ad for a drummer
Band adopts the name Maneskin (Danish for moonlight), suggested by half-Danish member Victoria De Angelis, to enter the local 'Pulse' competition
Runner-up on the 11th season of X Factor Italia, mentored by Manuel Agnelli; debut single 'Chosen' reaches #2 in Italy; EP 'Chosen' released in December
Debut studio album 'Il ballo della vita' released
Wins Sanremo Music Festival with 'Zitti e buoni'; second studio album 'Teatro d'ira: Vol. I' released
Wins Eurovision Song Contest 2021 in Rotterdam with 'Zitti e buoni'
Viral breakthrough: cover of 'Beggin'' and 'I Wanna Be Your Slave' chart worldwide; first Italian rock act in UK Top 10
Damiano David begins solo career; band goes on indefinite hiatus
